```yaml
name: Community Tests (No Secrets)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - dev
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  code_quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run lockfile validation
        run: pip-compile --check requirements.in

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        run: pre-commit run --all-files

      - name: Run Ruff check and format
        run: ruff check .
        env:
          RUFF_FORMAT: true

  unit_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    strategy:
      matrix:
        test-file: [
          'tests/unit/graph/',
          'tests/unit/chunking/',
          'tests/unit/retrieval/',
          'tests/unit/search/',
          'tests/unit/pipelines/',
          'tests/unit/visualization/',
          'tests/unit/ontology/',
          'tests/unit/permissions/',
          'tests/unit/cache/',
          'tests/unit/session/',
          'tests/unit/config/',
          'tests/unit/eval_framework/'
        ]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pytest ${{ matrix.test-file }} --cov=./ --cov-report=xml

  cli_unit_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    strategy:
      matrix:
        test-file: [
          'tests/cli/test_cli_command_1.py',
          'tests/cli/test_cli_command_2.py',
          'tests/cli/test_cli_command_3.py',
          'tests/cli/test_cli_command_4.py',
          'tests/cli/test_cli_command_5.py'
        ]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run CLI unit tests
        run: pytest ${{ matrix.test-file }}

  telemetry_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run telemetry test
        run: pytest tests/unit/telemetry/

  aggregate_results:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [code_quality, unit_tests, cli_unit_tests, telemetry_test]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Aggregate test results
        run: |
          echo "::group::Test Results"
          cat $(find . -name '*.xml')
          echo "::endgroup::"

      - name: Check if any test failed
        id: check-failed
        run: |
          if grep -q "<failure" $(find . -name '*.xml'); then
            echo "::error::Some tests have failed."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "::notice::All tests have passed."
            exit 0
          fi

      - name: Post test results as annotations
        uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          report_paths: "**/*.xml"
          test_files_prefix: "tests/"
          annotate_only: false
          check_annotations: true
          update_check: true
          check_name: "Community Tests (No Secrets)"
          commit: true
          fail_on_failure: true
          require_tests: true
          require_passed_tests: false
          include_passed: true
```
